big_case.notes: Although the petition framed a nationally significant doctrinal challenge to the McDonnell Douglas summary-judgment framework under Title VII and Rule 56 and attracted four cert-stage amicus briefs after the Call for a Response, the underlying case is a fact-bound single-employee termination affirmed in an unpublished Ninth Circuit memorandum disposition and resolved by a routine, unremarked denial of certiorari (no noted dissent), leaving circuit law unchanged.
